title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
summary: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
summary: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
summary: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
summary: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
summary: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
summary: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.

title: Stablecoin supply falls $14.2B in biggest 30-day drop since June 2022
summary: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.

title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
summary: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.
